# Repository Map

This is the canonical repository for the soccer-documentary YouTube studio.

## Start here

1. `docs/project/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`
2. `docs/project/CURRENT_STATUS.md`
3. `episodes/001-messi-hate/script/MASTER_PRODUCTION_SCRIPT.md`
4. `episodes/001-messi-hate/CLAIMS_LEDGER.md`
5. `integrations/BLENDERYT_MERGE_PLAN.md`

## Production areas

- `episodes/` — canonical per-video research, scripts, storyboards, and manifests
- `editorial/` — evidence and publication standards
- `scripts/` — Blender Python and local tooling
- `docs/videos/` — legacy creative drafts retained for comparison
- `docs/project/` — durable studio memory and decisions
- `schemas/` — machine-readable production contracts
- `tools/` — tool responsibilities and boundaries
- `outputs/` — ignored renders except placeholders

## Current Blender assets

- `scripts/scenes/001_chosen_boy_maradona_shadow.py`
- `scripts/01_cr7_slide_tackle_siu.py`

Both passed Python syntax checks. Runtime compatibility must be verified in the approved Mac Blender version.
